//: The guards friendly words and guard-log rules (specs/015-guard-ux, specs/024-guard-log): each guard prints them itself (ai-gent guard, the shell fallback in plugins/*/hooks/guard.sh, opencode/guard/rules.mjs). Copies: rust/crates/ai-gent-core/src/guard/words.json, opencode/guard/words.json and the generated block in each guard.sh; python3 scripts/consistency.py --sync-shared-code rewrites them.

entries.say: Hooks are never bypassed (--no-verify, -n).
entries.instead: fix what the hook reports, then commit again.

entries.match: commits, issues, pull requests and comments carry no sign-off
entries.say: Commits, issues, pull requests and comments carry no mention of the agent.
entries.instead: remove the Co-Authored-By or "generated with" line and run the command again.

entries.say: A plain force push can overwrite other people's commits.
entries.instead: use --force-with-lease, and only on the user's explicit order.

entries.say: Only you write the autonomy grant; an agent that could write it could give itself the permissions.
entries.instead: create or change the grant file yourself (expires, branches and actions lines).

entries.say: This publishes commits to the remote.
entries.allowIf: Allow only if you asked for this push.

entries.match: opening a PR publishes the branch
entries.say: This opens a pull request, which publishes the branch.
entries.allowIf: Allow only if you asked for it.

entries.say: This deletes a branch that may hold unmerged work.
entries.allowIf: Allow only if you asked for it; the workflow uses git branch -d.

entries.say: This rewrites history or discards work.
entries.allowIf: Allow only if you asked for it.

entries.match: the workflow works on a branch
entries.say: This commits or merges on a long-lived branch.
entries.allowIf: Allow only if you asked for it.

entries.say: This commits or merges on a branch higher in the chain.
entries.allowIf: Allow only if you asked to promote.

entries.say: This commits straight onto the integration branch.
entries.allowIf: Work goes on a branch merged into it; allow only if you meant this (concluding a merge is fine).

entries.say: Only dbrun reads database credential files.
entries.instead: use dbrun profiles, classify or test.

entries.say: A direct restore changes a database.
entries.instead: local restores go through dbrun restore; anything else is a script for a person to run.

entries.say: A direct client call would write to a database.
entries.instead: use dbrun (plan and apply on a proven local database, a script for anything else).

entries.say: This calls a database client directly: no classification, masking or command log.
entries.allowIf: Allow only if you want this direct call.

entries.say: Decrypting the store would show secret values.
entries.instead: the runner that needs a secret reads it.

entries.match: ai-gent/db/ entries are read only by dbrun
entries.say: Database passwords are read only by dbrun.

entries.match: hands the secret to a command that can print it
entries.say: This would hand a secret to a command that can print it.
entries.instead: run the tool that needs it after --.

entries.say: This would expose a secret value.
entries.instead: the runner that needs it reads it; the agent never does.

entries.match: the agent never writes a credential
entries.say: The agent never types a credential.
entries.instead: ask the user to run `pass insert <entry>` in their own terminal.

entries.say: This changes the password store.
This touches the list of pass entries the agent may read.
entries.allowIf: The user decides what the agent may read.

entries.match: that shows a secret value from pass
entries.say: This would show a secret value.
entries.instead: the agent sees names only (pass ls).

entries.match: work items, pull requests and comments carry no sign-off
entries.say: Issues, work items, pull requests and comments carry no mention of the agent.
entries.instead: remove the Co-Authored-By or "generated with" line and run the command again.

entries.say: This changes an issue, work item or pull request on the platform.
entries.allowIf: Allow only if you asked for exactly this change.

entries.say: A prune removes other projects' images, volumes and builds.
entries.instead: remove by ID, or by this project's label (containers.md §9a).

entries.say: Removing everything takes other projects' resources.
entries.instead: remove by ID or by this project's label (containers.md §9).

entries.match: removes whatever an unfiltered listing returns
entries.say: That removes whatever an unfiltered listing returns.
entries.instead: filter the listing by this project's label (containers.md §9a).
